test.fullName: Nesting depth — 32-level document limit rejects a 32-level ExpressionAttributeValue with ValidationException

splits.behaviour: UpdateItem carrying a 32-level ExpressionAttributeValue. 32 is the documented limit, so this is a boundary disagreement rather than a violation: strict regions reject it in validation, the rest accept the value and go on to evaluate the condition. Probed against a key that is never written, so the condition is false everywhere and a ConditionalCheckFailedException is proof the value was accepted rather than a sign of differing regional state. The test lives in tests/tier3/limits/, which sets no assertion-strictness convention. It asserts a ValidationException but matches the message with a regex that tolerates wording variants, so it pins the strict side without pinning the exact message, and this row is the only place the exact answers are pinned. Between the 2026-09-12 and 2026-09-19 sweeps af-south-1, ap-southeast-3, ap-southeast-4, ap-southeast-5 and il-central-1 moved to the strict side, leaving 22 strict and 11 lax as of the 2026-09-28 capture, with ap-northeast-1 answering both ways. By the 2026-10-03 sweep ap-northeast-1, ap-south-2, ap-southeast-6, ap-southeast-7, ca-central-1, eu-central-2, eu-south-1, eu-west-1 and us-east-2 had moved to the strict side, which three runs from separate processes on 2026-10-07 confirmed, leaving eu-south-2 and me-central-1 the only lax regions.

Thirty-one regions, eu-west-2 among them, size an update by what the statement writes plus a fixed cost per clause, leaving out the key and any attribute the statement does not touch, so at a short key the ceiling falls below 409,600 and the write this test makes one byte over it is refused. eu-south-2 and me-central-1 size it like any other write, capping the finished item at 409,600, and store it. ap-south-2, ap-southeast-6, ap-southeast-7, ca-central-1, eu-central-2, eu-south-1, eu-west-1 and us-east-2 did the same on every sweep from 2026-09-05 until the 2026-10-03 one found them on the statement-sized rule, which three runs from separate processes on 2026-10-07 confirmed. ap-northeast-1, which answered both ways in September and was in no row, gave the statement-sized answer on that sweep and all three runs, and joins that side.
